description: Provenance + regeneration parameters for the painterly tileset (see README.md)
model: gemini-3-pro-image-preview (Nano Banana Pro) via Vertex AI, project hex-general, location global

tile_spec.hex: flat-top, point-to-point width 128 (2x render HEX_SIZE=32; drawn at 64 world px, crisp at MAX_ZOOM=2)
tile_spec.mask: hexgeom.hex_mask(128,128) core >128, dilated 1px (bleed) so abutting tiles overlap real content instead of AA fading

plains.gates: all 49 candidates passed luminance band 100-125 (measured 109-120); picks from a 23-candidate mutually seam-compatible clique (pre-v2 seam metric); truncation 0 fails

woods.class: object field (composited sprites; never swatch-cut - user: no cut-off canopies, trees end before the hex edge)

segmentation.connected_components: 8-neighbour, min area 400 px (prompt asked 6x6 grid but got 7 columns; components make the layout irrelevant)

compose.edge_inset: centre of crown must satisfy in_hex with shrink 2 + 0.72*max(w,h)/2 (no tree crosses the true hex edge)
compose.draw_order: sorted by y_base ascending (lower trees composite over higher)
compose.floor_discs: per tree, r=0.72*w at crown centre, rgba(30,44,26,185), gaussian blur 2, clipped to dilated mask
compose.placements: woods/placements.json (exact per-tree x, y_base, size, sprite index)

woods.ratified: 2026-07-01 via woods/review/woods-final-*.png ('sprites and layout are great' + packed density per 'can't really see much of the ground')

hills.class: whole-hex vignette (composited hill formations via vignette.py; swatch-cut texture REJECTED 2026-07-01: relief contrast breaks seams - best swatch's largest seam-compatible clique was 2/49 cuts vs plains' 23, and flatten.py can't help because the contrast IS the ridges, not illumination)

segmentation.foreground: min-channel distance from white > 25, alpha ramp (dist-25)*255/60
segmentation.discovery: downsample 8x (block max), hole-fill via border-connected background components, 4 largest clusters, row-major order
segmentation.interior: forced opaque (erode 2 at low res) so bright rock never goes transparent
segmentation.unmatte: partial-alpha edge pixels un-matted from white (kills the halo)

grass_match.note: recolour option 'a' ratified from hills/review/hills-recolor-compare.png (columns: original|a|b|c); grass-weighted so rocky crests stay put; also drops whitish low-sat pixels near the alpha boundary (the 'whitish seam' the user flagged)

hills.ratified: 2026-07-01 ('Hills A'), applied tiles also archived at hills/picks/

city.class: settlement vignette (whole-hex composition on a grass rim via vignette.py)
style_refs: city/street-guide.png (layout diagram, NOT style: 6 streets to the flat-top hex edge midpoints at 30/90/150/210/270/330 deg, where roads will enter later)
city.segmentation: same recipe as hills.segmentation, no grass_match (city needs no recolour)
city.vignette_history: v1 organic (no spoke control) -> v2 six spokes but a perfect wheel with boulevard streets -> v3 ratified: six narrow lanes in the diagram directions, ragged organic outline
city.ratified: 2026-07-01 ('cities are good'), applied tiles also archived at city/picks/

town.class: settlement vignette (whole-hex composition on a grass rim via vignette.py; the smaller sibling of city)
style_refs: refs/town_a.png (concept1.png crop (950,240)-(1115,365), the small village at the road junction)
city/street-guide.png (layout diagram, NOT style: same 6 lane directions as city so roads can anchor at the flat-top hex edge midpoints later)
town.segmentation: same recipe as hills.segmentation, no grass_match (like city, town needs no recolour)
town.sheet_history: sheet 1 rejected (cluster 4 was a smeared generation failure; its 3 good clusters read more rural/sparse - offered as row town_b and not picked); sheet 2 ratified whole (all 4 clusters clean, denser small-town register)
town.ratified: 2026-07-01 ('Town a sounds fine', feature_px 80 vs the town_a90 size alternative; city-tile reference row in town/review/town-a-candidates.png), applied tiles also archived at town/picks/

concept_anchors.note: luminance bands are anchored by MEASURING docs/concept-art/concept1.png, not by fiat
